title: Attack to 40 and bank 50 Big bones
where: The Hill Giants in the Edgeville Dungeon: the trapdoor is in Edgeville, a few steps south-west of the bank, and the giants are in the south-east of the dungeon. If you have a Brass key, the locked door by the giants saves the walk past the skeletons. The Edgeville bank is a minute away: bank the bones there.

mapLocation.label: The trapdoor to the Edgeville Dungeon

itemsRequired.howToGet: From step S3-07. Wear it until Attack 40: the Rune scimitar needs 40 Attack.

Buy on the Grand Exchange, about 34 gp each (15 Oct 2026); Trout, Tuna, Lobster or Swordfish count too. About 2 Salmon a giant at Defence 1 (an estimate). One Big bone (about 330 gp) pays for about 10 Salmon.

itemsRecommended.howToGet: Grand Exchange, about 160 gp each (15 Oct 2026). A dose every 4-5 minutes: a higher max hit shortens every fight, so it saves food too.

fields.label: Goals
fields.text: Two in one block: Attack 40 with the Adamant scimitar, and at least 50 Big bones banked. A Hill Giant has 35 hit points, about 140 XP a kill, and always drops Big bones.

fields.label: Money
fields.text: Bank the Big bones, do not sell them in the dungeon: 50 of them are about 14,000-16,000 gp at the Grand Exchange (check the price when you sell). This pays for Wormbrain (10,000 gp in S5-05), the ship (2,000 gp in S5-06) and the materials in S4-05; the gap, if the price has moved, is shown by the preparation list. Bones in the bank are not coins until sold.

fields.label: Weapon
fields.text: Train with the Adamant scimitar. The Rune scimitar can be wielded only from Attack 40: once you reach it, the gear advice may offer it, it is not part of this step.

fields.label: Food
fields.text: At Defence 1 a Hill Giant hits about 4 times in 5 for up to 4, every 3.6 seconds, and with the Adamant scimitar at Strength 20 a fight lasts about a minute: plan about 2 Salmon a giant with a Strength potion, nearly 3 without (an estimate from the wiki stats and the combat formulas). Attack 30 to 40 is about 170 giants, roughly 370 Salmon with potions. The bones pay for it: every giant drops a Big bone, about 330 gp, the price of about 10 Salmon (15 Oct 2026).

fields.label: Armour
fields.text: No Defence training, so wear what you already have. The Anti-dragon shield (S5-02) stops Elvarg's fire whatever your Defence is, and the 18,650 Defence XP from Dragon Slayer I lifts Defence by itself. Hill Giants hit up to 4 and are aggressive: eat before your health falls to 8 (two hits), and earlier when two of them are on you.

membersAlternative: 👑 With membership: do not fight mobs by hand: complete Waterfall Quest in 15 minutes and get 30 Attack and 30 Strength at once!
doneWhen: Attack 40 and 50+ Big bones in the bank or the bag. Strength and Defence are left alone.

pathWaypoints.label: The trapdoor to the Edgeville Dungeon: climb down

quickSteps: Bank in Edgeville: fill the bag with Salmon (or other fish) and take the Strength potions; wield the Adamant scimitar and wear the Amulet of strength.
Climb down the trapdoor a few steps south-west of the bank; the Hill Giants are in the south-east of the dungeon.
Fight the Hill Giants on Accurate (Chop) to Attack 40. Eat at 8 health; drink a Strength potion dose every 4-5 minutes. When the food runs out, bank the Big bones in Edgeville and come back.
